summary_en: ROE target 8.0%+ during FY27-29 mid-term plan; annual dividend floor ¥35/share (higher than prior plan); total shareholder return ratio to be managed flexibly via opportunistic buybacks; execution through 4 strategic pillars: business portfolio clarity, robotics-led automation, sustainability integration, capital efficiency deepening.
title_en: Update on Initiatives toward Capital-Cost and Stock-Price Conscious Management
translation_en_brief:
On 25 June 2026, Kawada Technologies updated its capital-allocation and shareholder-return framework in alignment with its newly announced fourth mid-term plan (FY27–FY29).

Key metrics: The company targets ROE of 8.0% or higher during the plan period, achieved through improved profitability and disciplined capital deployment. The annual dividend floor is set at ¥35 per share, a material increase from the prior plan. The company will employ flexible self-share buybacks to manage total shareholder return ratio, calibrated to financial condition and market environment.

Rationale: Prior-period ROE (9.2% in FY25) declined from peak (12.8% in FY24) due to large project cycles extending beyond FY25 and equity-method investment fluctuations. PBR remained below 1.0x despite brief periods of parity, prompting intensified capital-efficiency focus. The four strategic pillars—business-portfolio clarity, construction–robotics automation technology, sustainability-driven operations, and capital efficiency—are designed to rebuild earnings power and underpin sustained ROE recovery and dividend growth.
